full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio photograph shows an elderly man in a dark suit and dotted bow tie against a nearly featureless black background. The frame crops below his chest, placing his broad shoulders across the lower left and leaving a large column of empty darkness on the right. His head is turned three quarters toward that open space, although his eyes glance back toward the camera. Sparse hair is combed back from a high forehead; the smooth scalp catches a pale highlight while the side of the head drops into deeper shade. Heavy brows, lines across the forehead, creases beneath the eyes, and the folds around the mouth are sharply visible. His mouth is closed and downturned, giving the face a grave, guarded expression. The left side of his face, nearest the picture's left edge, carries broad shadow, while a strong pool of light lands on the opposite forehead, eye area, nose, cheek, and chin. The nose casts a distinct dark shape across the middle of the face, and the jaw falls toward the black background. A crisp white shirt collar breaks through the dark clothing at the neck. Below it, a small black bow tie dotted with tiny white spots sits above a narrow bright shirt opening. The jacket is thick and matte, its lapels separated from the background by subtle gray tonal steps rather than a hard bright outline. At the lower right of the jacket, a pale folded pocket square gives one more compact highlight. The image has visible photographic grain and finely resolved skin texture, yet the empty background contains no distracting objects or text. The studio light is hard and directional from the upper right of the frame, creating dramatic relief over the face and allowing the far side to sink into black. The overall composition uses the man's illuminated features and a few small white clothing details to anchor a restrained, serious portrait within deep negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白影棚照片：一位穿深色西装、打波点领结的年长男子站在几乎没有可辨内容的黑色背景前。画框裁在胸部下方，宽阔的肩膀横过左下方，右侧留下大块空旷黑暗。他的头以四分之三角度转向那片空处，眼睛却回望相机。稀疏头发从高额头向后梳，光滑头顶接住浅色高光，头的一侧落入更深阴影。浓重眉毛、额头横纹、眼下细褶和口边皱纹都清晰可见。他闭着嘴，嘴角下垂，使神情显得严肃而戒备。靠画面左缘的脸部一侧有宽阔阴影，另一侧的额头、眼周、鼻梁、面颊和下巴则落着一片强光。鼻子在脸中央投下明显的深色形状，下颌逐渐没入黑色背景。脖颈处，利落的白衬衫领从深色衣物间显露。其下，点缀细小白点的黑色领结位于一小块明亮衬衫开口上方。外套厚重而哑光，翻领与背景只靠细微灰阶而非刺眼亮边分开。外套右下方，一块浅色折叠口袋巾形成另一个紧凑的亮点。画面有可见的摄影颗粒和细腻皮肤质感，但空背景里没有分散注意力的物件或文字。影棚硬光从画面右上方定向照来，让面部浮雕般凸起，并使背光侧沉入黑暗。整体构图以受光的五官和少量白色服饰细节为锚，在深重负空间中形成克制而严肃的肖像。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome studio photography concentrates a hard, directional beam on a limited central area and lets surrounding values descend rapidly toward black. The brightest gray and white accents are compact, giving a few surface planes immediate emphasis against extensive negative space. Tonal transitions follow real volume: sharply lit ridges meet deep recesses, while matte dark surfaces retain only enough gray to separate their edges. Fine grain and close textural detail remain visible in the illuminated portions. The background is plain and lightless, so attention moves among the high-contrast contours and smaller pale accents. The overall effect is formal, sculptural, and psychologically intense, with shadow carrying as much visual weight as the light.
style_prompt_zh: 单色影棚摄影把一束硬质定向光集中在有限的中心区域，并让周围明度迅速降至黑色。最亮的灰白重点十分紧凑，使少量受光表面在广阔负空间前立即突出。明暗过渡遵循真实体积：清楚受光的凸起连接深暗凹处，哑光深色表面仅保留足以区分边缘的一点灰阶。细密颗粒与近距离质地在受光区域仍可看见。背景简单且不受光，视线因而在强对比轮廓和较小浅色重点之间移动。整体效果正式、富有雕塑感且心理张力强，阴影与光亮具有同等视觉分量。
theme_en: A severe black-and-white studio portrait of an elderly man in a bow tie
theme_zh: 一位打领结的年长男子的严肃黑白影棚肖像
name: Yousuf Karsh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
